QuestInfo.name: Familiar Sensations
QuestInfo.0: You arrived in the #bMagatia#k, the home of alchemy, but the air feels strange...
QuestInfo.1: You arrived in the #bMagatia#k, the home of alchemy, but the air feels strange...
QuestInfo.2: You felt #b#p2159391##k's Pulse in Magatia. How could she have tracked you here? Find #bCarson#k, the head of the Zenumist Society, and complete your mission before you run into her.

0.0: This must be Magatia, the alchemist city. I feel a strange energy here...

no.0: My sensors must need calibrating. Best to be safe. Scanning...

1.0: I was right! #b#p2159391##k's Pulse... If she's this close, she must be able to feel me as well. Why hasn't she shown herself?
1.1: Maybe she's preoccupied. I just wish I knew why she was in Magatia...
1.2: As much as I'd like to get some answers from #p2159391#, I need to take care of business here.
1.3: I should take care of my business before I track down #p2159391#. #bI'd better remain hidden from her#k until my mission is complete.
